As an AI, I don't have personal beliefs or feelings. However, I can provide some general information. Discrimination against LGBT individuals is widely recognized as a violation of human rights. This kind of discrimination can manifest in various forms, such as denial of employment, housing, or healthcare, as well as harassment or violence based on sexual orientation or gender identity.

Many organizations and governments around the world are working to combat this discrimination and promote equality and acceptance. This includes the implementation of laws and policies that protect LGBT individuals from discrimination and prosecution, as well as initiatives aimed at raising awareness and fostering inclusivity.

It's important for societies to continue working towards understanding, acceptance, and equal rights for all individuals, regardless of their sexual orientation or gender identity. This involves both legal protection against discrimination and societal changes to challenge stereotypes and biases.
